claim.reading: The median of lifespan over all rows equals 6 when rounded to the printed precision.

message: Under the stated reading, the data file does not give the printed number.
proposal_origin_note: Who proposed this reading. A proposer has no authority; only the checks below count.

assumptions: Rounding: the printed value 6 stands for any exact value within ±1/2 of it (rounding to the last printed digit, ties accepted either way).
Missing values: cells equal to one of ['', 'NA'] are excluded; the count of excluded rows is part of the proof.
Every other cell in the columns used is read as an exact decimal number; no rows are added, removed or reweighted.

scope: REFUTED, for the data file BMdata.csv (SHA-256 b3712bff4020df73…) only: “The median of lifespan over all rows equals 6 when rounded to the printed precision.” This shows a mismatch between the printed number and this file under this reading. It does not show that the paper is wrong: the reading may be mistaken, or the authors may have analysed different rows or a different file version.
